claim_en: deshe ('sprout', the command's first product-word) — MS records the books DIVIDED: some read zaqef qatan (the small two-dot pause), the Sephardic books and the early print read revia, and Radak's Et Sofer rules for revia. SNAPSHOT carries the zaqef qatan — joining the camp MS argues against (split-attested accent station).

source: Minchat Shai on Torah, Gen 1:11 (the Michlol)

source: Minchat Shai on Torah, Gen 1:11 (the Michlol)

claim_en: THE NAMING GENERATES A CASE ROW, AND THE ROW CARRIES A THREE-WAY DISPUTE. The verse's own noun miqveh ('gathering') becomes the legal category of the ritual bath: R. Meir - ALL seas are as a mikveh, 'for it is said: and the GATHERING of the waters He called Seas'; R. Yehudah - the Great Sea alone (the plural marks many kinds of seas within it); R. Yosei - all seas purify as flowing streams yet are invalid for zavim, metzoraim, and sanctifying purification-waters.
